name: 47454 · Paoli, IN
findings: ZIP 47454 (Paoli) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47454 (Paoli) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 47454 (Paoli) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
